title: Aeterna Fragments
description: This mod adds a lot of fragments of different things to Minecraft.
body:
Our mod adds many magical fragments and tools for obtaining them to Minecraft.

Main items:

- **Soul Shard** — can be used as an immortality totem

- **Life Shard** — adds one heart

- **Mirror of Self-Denial** — takes one heart and becomes broken

- **Broken Mirror of Self-Denial** — can be converted into a soul shard at the crafting table

- **Mirror of Desecration** — extracts a mob’s soul

- **Broken Mirror of Desecration** — can be converted into a desecrated soul at the crafting table

- **Desecrated Shard** — a shard consisting of 9 desecrated souls. Can be converted into a soul shard at the crafting table.
  
- **Uncharged Lightning Shard** — can electrocute the holder.
 
- **Lightning Shard** — strikes lightning where you aim.

For more detailed recipes, play with our mod. Forge version — _47.0.19_. Good luck!
